title: l9.product-birth-binding/v2
description: The exact coordinates a caller claims when binding a compiler-resolved product realization to one repository birth: product id and kind as resolved by the semantic compiler, the ProductManifest and ProductTopology references and digests the manifest carries, the realized source snapshot, the compiled l9.birth-payload/v1 artifact by digest, the factory revision, and the exact semantic-compiler engine plus the exact input paths (inside the source snapshot) the manifest was compiled from. It is input to l9_birth_adapter.py, which holds every coordinate to the artifacts themselves, and to PREPARE, which re-runs the pinned engine against the same inputs and refuses birth unless the manifest reproduces. It is a closed shape: no repository shape, no kind hint, no inferred field, and no lineage or birth-contract coordinate is admitted. v2 supersedes l9.product-birth-binding/v1 (schemas/superseded/): the mandatory l9.repo-birth-contract/v1 and its IdeaOS / GAR / Plan / campaign / Program Execution lineage are no longer birth prerequisites. Semantic refs and digests (manifest, topology) are owned upstream and are opaque non-empty strings here; the payload digest is the factory convention `sha256:` over the artifact bytes.

product.description: Restates the product coordinates the manifest resolves. The adapter compares them; it never supplies them.

manifest.description: The exact ProductManifest: its semantic ref and the semantic digest it declares as manifest_digest. Compared as opaque strings by the adapter; reproduced by PREPARE through the pinned engine, never recomputed by the factory.

topology.description: The exact ProductTopology the manifest records as source_topology.

source.description: The realized source snapshot the compiled payload binds and the manifest was compiled from.

payload.description: The exact compiled l9.birth-payload/v1 artifact: every byte the birth may consume, from that snapshot.

factory.description: The exact birth factory the realization is bound to. Explicit, never defaulted.

compiler.description: The exact semantic-compiler engine that resolved the ProductManifest, and the exact inputs it read. PREPARE admits only the engine the factory pins (scripts/birth-runner/semantic-compiler.pin.json) and re-runs its product-build capability against these inputs inside the verified payload tree.

inputs.description: Repository-relative paths inside the source snapshot, each a file the compiled payload names. contract_catalog is optional: a product whose RepositorySpec declares no local contract catalog has none to bind, and the engine's own default is then resolved against the source root.
